label: Rømme
note: Ordinary rømme (lettrømme) has 18-20 % fat; seterrømme has 35 %, the same as the cream it is made from, and is the one used to cook rømmegrøt

about.text: Norway's soured cream, made from cream, or a mix of whole milk and cream, soured with a natural or added lactic culture. Ordinary rømme has 18-20 % fat, seterrømme 35 %. Eaten on pancakes and waffles, with rakfisk, and cooked into rømmegrøt.

how.text: Cream, or whole milk mixed with cream, is soured by natural or added lactic acid bacteria. The source gives no species, temperatures or times.
